exceptions.reason: The finding existed at the PR-01 base. Moving Auth.js to the fixed beta changes authentication-critical code and requires focused login, session, and failure-mode regression work outside this hardening-only PR.
exceptions.mitigation: Current authorization checks require auth.user rather than treating any auth object as authenticated; this narrows the described fail-open path but is not accepted as remediation.

exceptions.reason: The vulnerable Auth.js beta existed at the PR-01 base. Its upgrade belongs in PR-02 so email normalization, allowlisting, and every configured sign-in path can be regression-tested together.
exceptions.mitigation: Email sign-in is only enabled when the Resend configuration is present, but that does not remove the vulnerable normalization code when enabled.

exceptions.reason: The finding existed at the PR-01 base. Updating the authentication beta is intentionally deferred to PR-02 for isolated auth regression testing.
exceptions.mitigation: No getToken or next-auth/jwt call exists in the repository, so the documented malformed-Bearer path is not currently invoked directly; this is not treated as a fix.

exceptions.mitigation: Email sign-in is configuration-gated; the vulnerable nested package remains present and no remediation is claimed.

exceptions.reason: This nested dependency and advisory existed at the PR-01 base. Coordinated Auth.js remediation is reserved for PR-02 to avoid an unreviewed auth change here.

exceptions.mitigation: Protected routes reduce anonymous product access, but this is not considered remediation for a framework parser/resource-exhaustion finding.

exceptions.reason: The finding applies to the existing Next.js version. A framework upgrade plus App Router regression testing is outside the no-upgrade scope of this continuation and is assigned to PR-02.
exceptions.mitigation: No code-level mitigation is claimed; the exception is deliberately short-lived and exact-version bound.

exceptions.mitigation: No custom Node server or WebSocket Upgrade handler is present in this repository, so the advisory's documented application condition was not identified; this is not a version fix.

exceptions.reason: The installed framework version is in the advisory range. Upgrading Next.js is deferred to the dedicated dependency-remediation PR.

exceptions.reason: The locked Next.js release is affected by version. Framework remediation is deferred to PR-02 for a separately reviewable upgrade.
